summary: Implemented the grid-sampled patch feature without running any tests or code, per instructions. Changes: monai/data/utils.py (iter_patch now yields (patch, coords) pairs with coordinates computed by removing padding offsets; docstring updated; set_rnd skips double-underscore attributes); monai/data/grid_dataset.py (new PatchIter generator wrapping iter_patch; GridPatchDataset reworked to take patch_iter, transform, with_coordinates with NumPy-based worker split and apply_transform per patch; PatchDataset example uses float; math import removed); monai/data/__init__.py (exports PatchIter); docs/source/data.rst (PatchIter autodoc entry after GridPatchDataset); tests/test_grid_dataset.py (TestGridPatchDataset with test_shape and test_loading_array). Nothing was committed. Not verified: pytest results, and the pinned patch values in test_loading_array, which are copied from the spec. Pre-existing lines 231-233 in utils.py exceed 120 columns and were left alone.
